description: Example connector showing MCP prompts: reusable prompt templates with arguments.
instructions: Copy this folder to start a connector that ships reusable prompts. Each prompt declares its arguments; required arguments must be supplied when the prompt is fetched. The connector renders a prompt into messages; keep prompts focused on one task and name arguments plainly.
name: example-prompts

arguments.description: Summary style, e.g. concise or detailed.
arguments.name: style
arguments.title: Style

prompts.description: Summarize a piece of text in a chosen style.
prompts.name: summarize
prompts.title: Summarize text
